name: Star Alliance (United)
description: Fuselage: all white. Titles: very large, thin, widely spaced 'STAR ALLIANCE' in black capitals from behind the forward door to over the wing's trailing edge, the cabin windows through their lower half; United's small Rhapsody-blue 'UNITED' with the globe in a blue box low on the forward fuselage; the small Star Alliance star behind the cockpit. Tail: black fin and dorsal fillet with the Star Alliance star (five white faceted triangles) large across its middle. Engines and winglets: Rhapsody blue, as United's 2019 scheme.

logos.description: The Star Alliance star, large across the fin's middle: five white triangles, each faceted like a low pyramid (one face lit, two shaded), set round a pentagon, the whole about as wide as the chord there.
The small gray Star Alliance star just behind the cockpit windows, as on United's standard.
United's globe in a small Rhapsody-blue square box, just after 'UNITED', low on the forward fuselage.
A small US flag after the registration, over the rear windows.

titles.style: The Star Alliance wordmark: very large, thin, widely spaced geometric capitals, the windows through their lower half. Spaced far wider than any typeface sets it (a stand-in spread to its length comes out heavy), so it names a mark.
United's wordmark, small, in Rhapsody blue under the forward windows, the globe box after it.

notes: Measured on 737-800 N76516 (left, 2025-05-11, fitted to shapes/B738.json with the doors and fin tip; fit within about 14 px, a third of a metre) and checked on N26210 (2025-06-21, three-quarter rear, so only its colours and layout used). 'STAR ALLIANCE' runs x 0.147-0.711, its baseline just under the windows (y about 0.04), cap height to y about 0.66; 'UNITED' x 0.149-0.228, cap 0.155; the fin's star centred x 0.61, y 0.32, 0.40 of the fin's span tall. The fin's black carries forward over the dorsal fillet (fin.fillet). The same scheme flies on United's 757-200, 767-300ER/-400ER and 777-200ER (photos 2024-2026); their placement comes from the 737 by landmarks, not measured on each type. The registration (black, above the rear windows) isn't drawn. The 2010-era Star Alliance jets had the same layout with United's 2010 gold-globe title and gray engines; every Commons photo since 2024 shows the blue (2019) details drawn here.
history: United's Star Alliance jets: N14219 (737-800) caught by the maintainer 2026-11-22 in this scheme, drawn in United's standard until now.
